limitations: The finite molecular/PES domain and its omitted tails are unvalidated. Full proposal support and synthetic checks do not establish adequate sampling in256points per target.
Only eight excluded diagnostic seed vectors; empirical ESS or maximum observed weight does not certify precision or bound unseen tails.
Even complete output establishes cost/weight diagnostics only, not asymptotic Rinf convergence, a thermal rate, paper agreement, quantum correction or recrossing.
Resource preflight failures, partial output and all numerical failures must remain recorded; there is no automatic retry or selected seed replacement.
math_and_data_path: to_chart/from_chart use a proper rotation gauge and retain r^2*s^2; reflected means change proposal coverage without adding physical symmetry factors.
Shape and full-sphere direction densities evaluate the full normalized mixtures. Uniform-box support covers every declared finite-domain shape.

Positive root, analytic inverse-mass metric, radial derivative, active max channel and connected-component tests implement the reviewed coarea surface. Invalid geometric draws stay zero in the unconditional sample counts.

The four separately sampled transition-channel means are summed exactly once. Entry uses one chart/full sphere. The aggregate diagnostic ratio divides pooled integral means; it does not average noisy seed ratios.
The two alpha surfaces share latent shape/direction draws, while each whole seed retains its own entry denominator. No converted rate or paper-agreement field is produced.
All768 target records and their geometric zero reasons are materialized and hashed before PES evaluation, then deterministically reconstructed and verified by registration loading.
PES failure/nonfinite values stop the attempt and remain explicit failure records, without replacement or interpretation as zero. All-zero integrals are unresolved without epsilon substitution.
provenance_requirements_before_actual_ca: The separate execution plan must bind these exact source/test/synthetic/review hashes, fixed proposal bytes, library/build inputs and actual imported modules.
One CPU affinity and all numerical thread environment variables equal1 are checked before creating the potential.
The frozen original scientific sources, model coefficients, units and known gradient-conversion caveat remain unchanged; energy alone defines this pilot weight.
Root adoption/resource authorization and the exact launch receipt remain separate from this code-review receipt.

resource_review.actual_vs_conservative_cost: Reports distinguish measured process CPU from conservative charged caps and bounded finalization reserves. Synthetic fixtures verify distinct parent/worker limits.
resource_review.one_attempt: Persistent RUN_ONCE and WORKER_ONCE markers, registration hashes and actual supervisor-parent PID bind the only worker and reject a second/direct attempt.
resource_review.previous_gap: The prior candidate omitted supervisor preflight and preparation import/finalization CPU from its combined budget.
resource_review.resolution: Dedicated preparation process records cumulative process_time and installs a charged integer hard cap. The supervisor includes cumulative preflight/import CPU plus a finalization reserve. Worker receives the remaining integer cap; all three charged caps sum to60seconds.
resource_review.wall_scope: Supervisor wall timer begins before registration revalidation and uses the remaining120seconds when waiting for its only worker; timeout kills and waits for that worker.
resource_review.worker_cap_timing: Worker allocation is installed before NumPy/SciPy imports and counts its full process lifetime. The55second admission test charges both prior process caps plus the worker current CPU.

verdict: No remaining blocker found for the adopted excluded finite-domain cost/weight pilot. This review is of the frozen implementation and recorded synthetic gate; it is not a PES evaluation or physical-rate validation.
